scope: Scene2 structure, initial object fields and two model-file prefixes from the base ALPS1 mission archive; not complete format specifications.

corroboration.observation: Uses quaternion at frame+0xc0 and multiplies basis components by scale at +0xd0/+0xd4/+0xd8.
Rotation formula uses quaternion vector components at +0/+4/+8 and scalar at +0xc.

chunk_header.encoding: little-endian uint16 id, uint32 total length INCLUDING header

object_fields.evidence: 006cdf32 branch checks actual frame type at +0xf8 against 9, reads a bounded string, strips its last-dot suffix, then follows cached/uncached resource handling. Failure reports modelfile '%s' not found at 006ce750.

normalization.rule: Scan backward over the entire string; at the last dot, terminate the name. No path-component restriction or case conversion in this step.
normalization.caveat: This is not generic filesystem suffix handling. A dot in a directory component can also truncate the name. Leading dots and trailing dots are included.

object_fields.caveat: The inspector decodes serialization without claiming the field is applied. Active creation kind is a request, not proof of actual runtime frame type. Resource directories, suffix addition, cache behavior and successful loads are unresolved.

object_fields.meaning: Object name, not necessarily a newly created object
object_fields.evidence: 006cdac7 reads the name. Creation kind starts at zero each record. Zero selects the name-table lookup path at 006cdb34; nonzero selects a create-if-missing path and driver dispatch at 006cdbed.
object_fields.caveat: Name-table registration is visible in callback 006cc580, passed to the scene interface by 006cbf30. A serialized request is not proof of runtime creation or successful lookup.

object_fields.meaning: 32-bit creation kind, active for subsequent name fields
object_fields.caveat: Engine type-name query 10019f00 identifies kinds 1 through 16, including 2=FRAME_LIGHT, 3=FRAME_CAMERA, 6=FRAME_DUMMY, 9=FRAME_MODEL. Serialized requests do not establish successful runtime creation.

object_fields.confidence: high for position dataflow; coordinate conventions not reconstructed

object_fields.meaning: Quaternion rotation, four little-endian float32 values in file order w,x,y,z
object_fields.evidence: Loader reorders to engine x,y,z,w; setter copies four components and calls imported S_quat::Normalize at 0041d1a4. Inspector preserves file values and reports the reorder, without silently normalizing.

object_fields.meaning: Fallback position vector used when the parent-name lookup fails
object_fields.caveat: Do not treat this as an independently resolved world-space position.

object_fields.evidence: Default is (1,1,1); named engine matrix-update code uses these components as basis multipliers.

object_fields.meaning: Parent reference container, observed with one 0x0010 name child
object_fields.caveat: Only 200 of 1200 parent names also occur in scene2 records; the remaining names are not automatically broken references. The loader's name table includes scene frames outside these records.

static_anchors.role: scene2.bin loader; checks root 0x4c53 and invokes 006cc760
Root chunk dispatcher; 0x4000 branch invokes 006cd940 for 0x4010 children
Object-record reader with cases including 0x0010, 0x4011 and 0x4020
static_anchors.confidence: high for framing, incomplete for field semantics

static_anchors.role: Read wrapper bounded by the current chunk end

analysis_repair.change: Apply Ghidra's existing alloca_probe call fixup to the verified x86 stack-probe helper, in the independent research project only.
analysis_repair.result: 006cd940 unknown in_stack_ occurrences fell from 122 to 0; impossible stack array disappeared. Type propagation and call signatures remain unreliable.

signature_repair.scope: Three archive imports and three chunk helpers in independent research project only; no executable bytes modified.
signature_repair.basis: rw_data.dll exports _dtaSeek@12, _dtaRead@12, _dtaWrite@12; callers push three arguments. Helpers use ECX for this and RET 4/8/4.
signature_repair.result: Chunk-entry pseudocode now recovers the 6-byte header length and out-ID correctly. Bare dtaSeek() calls in 006cd940 fell from 96 to zero after the earlier stack-probe fix.
signature_repair.remaining: Other helper and virtual-interface signatures are still incomplete; type propagation warnings remain.

exports.signature: int __stdcall dtaSeek(uint handle, int offset, int origin)
int __stdcall dtaRead(uint handle, void * buffer, uint count)
int __stdcall dtaWrite(uint handle, void * buffer, uint count)
bool __thiscall FUN_00405940(void * this, void * buffer, uint count)

limitations: 4008 object records does not mean 4008 soldiers, enemies, or distinct gameplay entities.
Only known scene/object container levels and parent-name containers are parsed; other payloads remain opaque.
Selected placement/name fields are decoded, not gameplay properties, full reference resolution or engine virtual interfaces.
Optional object decoding preserves serialized field order and requires ASCII names, exact known widths and finite floats.
Only a base-archive sample has been checked; patches may replace the runtime mission.
ISD1 and audio-specific codecs are unsupported by the native extractor.
Signatures and stack analysis beyond the verified probe fix still require work.
No game execution, Proton debugging, or Sabre Squadron format comparison.

prior_art.use: ISD0 header/index facts, published base-archive keys and community tool attempt; source not copied.
Block framing and LZSS/RLE format facts, checked against local data; source not copied.
